entities.summary: Wallace Gordon Bryant Jr. is a retired American professional basketball player who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) and other leagues. A 7 feet 0 inches (2.13 m), 245 pounds (111 kg) pound center, born in Torrejón de Ardoz, Bryant attended Emerson High School in Gary, Indiana, before playing at the University of San Francisco.
